name: Figma
notes: Current lockup (icon on black tile + wordmark). The kit's 1024x640 artboard padding was trimmed by tightening the viewBox; paths are unchanged. Black and white logos are allowed, but the kit has no one-colour lockup, and recolouring the full-colour icon would break it, so no mono file was made. Your own branding must be larger and more prominent than Figma's marks. Don't modify the logo, imitate its look or imply endorsement.

name: Webflow
notes: Use the blue mark whenever possible. Black and white versions exist for backgrounds where blue fails. Don't put the default logo on a colour, don't drop the mark from the logo, don't stack the logo vertically, and add no gradients or effects. Mono file is the official all-black version with fills set to currentColor. Use it only in black (#080808) or white.

name: Stripe
notes: The wordmark may appear only in blurple or slate (light backgrounds) or white (dark backgrounds): 'Do not use any other colour for the wordmark.' So no currentColor mono was made. If a neutral row is needed, use the official Slate SVG from the same kit. Use is subject to the Stripe Marks Usage Agreement.

name: PostHog
logoSource: https://posthog.com/handbook/brand/assets (rendered from the official @posthog/brand@0.13.0 library, which the page names as its source of truth: <Logo variant='gradient'/> and <Logo variant='mono'/>)
notes: Current gradient logo (2026 @posthog/brand). Use the standard logo on light backgrounds and the light (white) logo on dark ones. Use the solid single-colour logo only 'when a single-color mark is required'. Never change the colours in the logomark. Use the logo unmodified and never as your own main branding. The hedgehog mascot is not allowed in commercial materials without permission.

name: Clay
logoSource: https://www.clay.com (brand menu on the nav logo -> 'Download brand assets': https://assets.clayrun.dev/Clay%20Kiln%20Logos%202025.zip, file 'Full Mark/Dark/Clay_Logo_Primary_Blk@2x.png', 1596x503)
notes: 2025 'Kiln' identity. The kit's SVGs embed a ~6.6 MB raster of the 3D kiln, so the official 1596x503 PNG is used instead; convert it to WebP/AVIF at build time. The kiln is always full colour and the kit has no one-colour version, so there is no mono file. A white-wordmark version exists in the kit under Full Mark/Light for dark backgrounds.

name: Apollo.io
logoSource: https://www.apollo.io (official inline SVG in the site header, 'Link back to homepage')
notes: Current 2024+ Apollo identity: yellow burst plus 'Apollo' wordmark. No public brand or press kit was found, so this is the official mark served on apollo.io. With no published single-colour rules, no mono file was made. Keep the yellow burst and dark wordmark as served.

name: Unify
logoSource: https://www.unifygtm.com (official inline SVG in the site header, nav-logo_link)
notes: Wordmark-only logo, natively one dark colour. No public brand guidelines were found, so it wasn't recoloured. It already reads as monochrome on light backgrounds.

name: Instantly
notes: Current blue bolt-circle plus black wordmark. The source had no viewBox, so one was added from its width/height (0 0 123 28). No public brand guidelines were found. The site does use an all-white lockup on dark sections, but with no published rule no mono file was made.

name: HeyReach
logoSource: https://www.heyreach.io (brand menu on the nav logo -> brand kit https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=1h6W38SDHPKgkf-8Ehr-lC2-4BxoP4ApH; HeyReach_Logo-Primary-Dark.svg / HeyReach_Logo-Secondary-Dark.svg)
notes: Primary = colour-streak hand plus dark wordmark. The official kit includes a one-colour 'Secondary' lockup (black hand and wordmark), which is the source of the mono file. The '-Light' kit versions are for dark backgrounds.

name: HubSpot
notes: 2025 rebrand logo (#FF4800). The kit also has a Cream version (#F8F5EE) for dark backgrounds. Its trademark guidelines (https://legal.hubspot.com/tm-usage-guidelines) forbid changing the logo's colour, altering it, using old versions, adding words right around it or overlapping it with shapes. They also say you can't place HubSpot logos on your website without written permission, unless you're in a HubSpot partner program. Confirm Anurag's partner status, or get permission or use the text name only, before shipping this logo.

name: Attio
notes: The official lockup is black, and the kit also has white. Use the logo and wordmark together, never the wordmark alone or the name typeset in its place. Keep clear space, and don't warp, stretch, recolour or redraw. Render the mono file only in black or white.

name: n8n
notes: The logo may appear only in brand colours: Pink #EA4B71, Dark #040506 or White. Clear space is 4X around the logo, and the minimum width is 100px (30mm). Don't use the wordmark alone, stack vertically, add shadows, put it on busy backgrounds, tilt, squeeze, stretch, reverse the icon and wordmark, or change spacing or proportions. Render the mono file only in #040506 or white.

name: OpenAI
notes: Primary wordmark (OpenAI Sans). The Blossom symbol must not be used as primary branding or alongside the wordmark. Black and white only: no added colours or effects, no stretching or cropping. The kit's 1212x542 artboard includes prescribed clear space, and the viewBox was tightened to the artwork, so restore the prescribed clear space in CSS. The original artboard pads about 0.78x the wordmark height on every side (original viewBox 0 0 1212 542). Use the logo only where it directly relates to OpenAI services, never more prominent than your own brand, and don't imply partnership or endorsement. By using the logos you agree to OpenAI's Marks usage terms.

name: Claude (Anthropic)
logoSource: https://www.anthropic.com/press-kit (redirects to the Anthropic media resources zip; 'Claude logos/1 Claude logo/SVG/Claude logo - Slate.svg' and 'Claude logo - One-color.svg')
notes: Claude logo = clay-coloured spark plus slate wordmark. The kit ships an official One-color version (white), which is the mono source. The kit also has Anthropic corporate logos if the designer prefers 'Anthropic' over 'Claude', but Anurag uses the product, so Claude is the right mark. Don't redraw or recolour beyond the kit's Slate, Ivory and One-color versions.

name: Gong
logoSource: https://www.gong.io (header logo SVG https://cdn.sanity.io/images/ww20clc6/production/0b50133901322a215dfcf2f3311fc378ffdaacd6-117x42.svg); checked against the official kit at https://www.gong.io/media-kit -> https://www.lingoapp.com/112942/k/Logos-and-Guidelines-RkDQJ9 (PNG only)
notes: Primary lockup: violet burst #7121DB plus dark-purple wordmark #1D0254. The official Lingo kit (PNG only, 3601x3600) includes all-black and all-white versions of the same lockup, so the mono file (site SVG set to currentColor) matches an official variant. Render it only in black or white.

name: Slack
notes: The current official logo is the 'slack from Salesforce' lockup, the same one in slack.com's header. The media kit has only this lockup and the standalone hash icon, not a plain 'slack' wordmark. The mono file is the official black version. A white version exists for dark backgrounds. Follow Slack's brand guidelines, and email feedback@slack.com with a mock-up for any non-standard use.

name: Notion
logoSource: https://notion.notion.site/Logos-6331ef1fc18241f8bae8a4b923b05ce4 (official Notion Brand Guidelines, notion-logos-2024.zip: notion-logo-lockup-main.svg, notion-logo-lockup-mono-white.svg)
notes: Use the lockup (block plus 'Notion') as the primary identifier. Mono black and white versions are 'only to be used in situations where color use is limited'. On dark backgrounds use mono white, and don't use the sticker version on light ones. Don't use the wordmark alone, invert, add effects, distort, rotate, change the fonts, resize the 'N' or change what's inside the block. The mono file comes from the official mono-white geometry (transparent block face), so it reads correctly in black or white.

name: Granola
logoSource: https://grano.la/press -> public Drive press kit (Logos/1. Granola logo lockup/For screen/SVG/Granola_lockup_black.svg: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1dlVH9mQBf0aXlD_nIXlfd3DQogaiFaHH)
notes: Spiral plus wordmark. The official kit ships one-colour versions only: black #1E1E1E, green #B2C248 and neutral #EBEBE4, plus reversed-out ones. The 1850x500 artboard padding was trimmed by tightening the viewBox (paths unchanged). Render the mono file only in an official kit colour.
